test_notes: Verifies system.properties override path and chronicle.init.runnable run before Jvm static initialisation.
Confirms chronicle.init.runnable executes and toggles resource tracing flags.
Ensures chronicle.postinit.runnable is invoked and influences process exit status.
Validates optional safepoint toggles and related JVM hooks.
Exercises primitive reads and writes plus CAS operations against native addresses.
Checks volatile memory access semantics for long operations on native memory.
Asserts deterministic close semantics and closed-state enforcement.
Validates reserve and release lifecycle and deallocation at zero references.
Confirms reference owner tracking and leak diagnostics.
Exercises deferred resource release and background thread shutdown paths.
Checks single-threaded access guards and reporting.
JLBH microbenchmark to prove <1% overhead when tracing is disabled versus enabled.
JLBH microbenchmark measuring latency tails with optional safepoints toggled.
JLBH microbenchmark for throughput/allocation of Memory/UnsafeMemory hot paths.
Unit test to enforce mmap whitelist and reject disallowed paths/cleaners.
CI job ensuring `mvn -q clean verify` (tests/coverage/static analysis) gates merges for Chronicle-Core.
Simulate missing JNA/Posix to ensure fail-fast logging or explicit dummy fallback.
Validate `Slf4jExceptionHandler` emits ISO timestamps and no colour codes.
Ensures tracing toggles remain optional and do not destabilise reference counting.
Verifies background releaser can be stopped and pending work drained.
Shows operators can inject Chronicle Init hooks and external property files.
Ensure each deprecated API logs a single WARN with replacement guidance.
Ensure JNA defaults to dummy affinity when natives cannot be loaded.
CI validation that release artefacts are signed and SHA256 hashes are present in outputs.
Assert pauser counters/timers are exposed for Chronicle-Threads integration.
